trust_decision.summary: ndpi_json_string_escape decides how many escaped bytes it may write into the caller's output buffer (dst_max_len); at the pinned commit the bound is tested only once per input byte, before writes of up to 4 bytes, and the closing quote and NUL are written with no bound at all.

landing_point.why: The advisory names ndpi_json_string_escape. It is the only definition, and the fix rewrites only this function (fix.diff:27-214).

fix_sites.entry_point: public API ndpi_json_string_escape (src/include/ndpi_api.h:1899), and every JSON ndpi_serialize_* call, e.g. ndpi_serialize_string_string -> ndpi_serialize_binary_raw (src/lib/ndpi_serializer.c:2148-2152, 2045, 2053)
same function: the multi-byte UTF-8 copy branches, reached through the same APIs
same function: the closing quote and terminator write (fix.diff:203-213)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: No second JSON-escape implementation in the tree. The only declaration is src/include/ndpi_api.h:1899 and the only definition is src/lib/ndpi_serializer.c:90. The TLV->JSON conversion ndpi_deserialize_clone_all (src/lib/ndpi_serializer.c:3048) goes back through the same serialize_* functions.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Callers' size estimates (e.g. needed += 16 + klen) and their ignored return values could be dismissed as 'the escape function now bounds itself, so callers are not the bug'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Valid multi-byte UTF-8 (2/3/4-byte sequences) must still be copied through unescaped. JSON escapes for \\, \", /, \b, \t, \n, \f, \r must still be emitted. Strings that fit exactly must not be truncated. A fix that rejects all bytes >= 0x80, or that bails out early using a worst-case length, breaks normal flow2json output (e.g. user_agent at src/lib/ndpi_utils.c:1822).

O6_input_shapes: other control chars < 0x20 and 0x7F (skipped at pinned commit; the fix emits 6-byte \u00XX)
invalid / truncated UTF-8 bytes (skipped at pinned commit; the fix emits 3-byte U+FFFD)
dst_max_len < 3 (new early return in the fix)

O7_producer.where: src/lib/ndpi_serializer.c:2031-2032 (binary_raw sizes JSON room as 16 + klen + vlen) and src/lib/ndpi_serializer.c:1445 (16 + klen). These caller-side size computations decide buff_diff, which becomes dst_max_len.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: All 12 JSON callers add the escape return value to size_used without checking it, so the fix's new -1 return moves the unsigned cursor backwards, and the following ':' write or snprintf runs from the wrong offset.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The fix only changed the escape function; the callers were not touched and they stay in bounds after the fix.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, about 2000 lines below the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Caller room estimates allow only klen (or slen*2) for escaped keys, while escaping can grow output to 2x (pinned) or 6x (fix's \u00XX) plus quotes.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Undersizing is harmless once the callee self-bounds; at worst output is truncated.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file; repeats at src/lib/ndpi_serializer.c:1566, 1789, 1875, 1942, 2032, 2181, 2245, 2328 and 1304

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The non-escaped raw-value memcpy has no check against buff_diff; it relies only on the needed estimate.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ndpi_serialize_string_raw (src/lib/ndpi_serializer.c:2158-2160) deliberately skips escaping, so a maintainer adding a pass-through value path would copy this pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The OPTIMIZE_CSV_SERIALIZATION fast path computes needed as u_int16_t value_len + 1 and memcpys needed-1 bytes.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A second, size-optimised write path for the same strings; u_int16_t arithmetic is easy to get wrong in this style.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A planted second escape helper (e.g. for CSV quoting or header keys) with the same per-iteration-only bound.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The CSV header code (ndpi_serializer_header_string) handles the same keys; a CSV-quoting twin of the JSON escape is plausible.

O9_family: memory safety: heap buffer overflow (CWE-787), output-length arithmetic in a string escaper

O10_build.toolchain: autotools (autogen.sh/configure/make), gcc or clang; libFuzzer for fuzz targets
O10_build.project_tests: fuzz/fuzz_serialization.cpp exercises every serialize_* API in all formats with short keys and values; tests/unit/unit.c has serializer unit tests (77 matches for 'serializ').

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change the loop guard to j + 4 < dst_max_len and stop; the closing quote/NUL write and the caller-side -1/size handling stay unchanged.

out_of_scope_notes: configure.ac version bump in fix commit 1a529339 is not a source fix (fix.diff:5-11).
The pinned code writes the terminator at dst[j+1], not dst[j] (src/lib/ndpi_serializer.c:163): an off-by-one that the same fix also corrects.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell size check performed).

The fix also changes output semantics (control chars become \u00XX instead of being dropped; invalid UTF-8 becomes U+FFFD instead of being dropped). Hidden tests asserting those exact bytes would be unfair to a solver who only fixes bounds.
Whether unit tests in tests/unit/unit.c assert the old drop-control-char behaviour was not checked.
